newsitem.title: USA: Paxar's unit gets all notes in tender.
newsitem.headline: Paxar's unit gets all notes in tender.

text.p: Paxar Corp said Friday that its Monarch Marking Systems unit received tenders of all $100 million of Monarch's 12.5 percent senior notes due 2003, prior to the April 10, 1997 expiration of its tender offer for those notes.

Paxar said redemption of all the outstanding Monarch notes represents the successful completion of the second stage of Paxar's strategy to purchase Monarch and allows Paxar to replace this high-yield debt with lower-cost financing.
Paxar is in the apparel identification business.
Monarch, a wholly owned subsidiary of Paxar, is a supplier of identification and tracking solutions to retail and industrial customers worldwide.
Together, Paxar and Monarch market and distribute their products in more than 75 countries, Paxar said.
